title: Gyidi a Ahintaw Ho Nne
intro: Wɔ ahemfie atirimɔdenfo bi koma mu, baabi a na gyidi a wonni yɛ asase no mmara no, ɔkra bi a ɔyɛ ankonam nantew gyidi ne ehu hama a emu yɛ den mu. Saa ankorankoro yi a ɔbɛn tumi mfinimfini no tiee bere a wɔde animtiaabu ne ahunahuna hyiaa odiyifo bi nkrasɛm no. Nokware bere tiaa bi bae, na ɛhyɛɛ onipa yi ma ɔpaw ahobammɔ a ɛyɛ komm ne nokware a asiane wom a ɔbɛka. So wubetumi ahu onii ko a ɔkamfofo akokodurufo yi yɛ?
clues: Na mete otirimɔdenfo bi fie ankasa mu, na m’ankasa mihuu ahantan a ɛpow ɔsoro nsɛnkyerɛnne no.
Mede me gyidi yɛɛ kokoam, ademude a ahintaw wɔ abosonsom ahemfie bi mu.
Metee sɛ ɔkannifoɔ a mesom no no abɔ pɔw sɛ ɔbɛkum Allah somafoɔ bi, ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Musa.
Migyee wɔn ntease ho kyim, na mekaee wɔn Nuh, ‘Ad, ne Thamud nkurɔfo no nkrabea.
Mibisaa me nkurɔfo asɛm bi a ɛho hia sɛ: ‘Sɛ ɔyɛ ɔtorofo a, n’atoro da no so; nanso sɛ ɔka nokware a, nea ɔhyɛɛ bɔ no bi bɛbɔ wo.’
Wɔka m’asɛm no sɛ gyidie nhwɛsoɔ wɔ surah a wɔato din ‘Ɔfakyɛfoɔ’ no mu, baabi a mebɔɔ ​​me nkurɔfoɔ kɔkɔ wɔ tumidifoɔ nsisi ho.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
